theorem factorial_sum_identity (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.range (N + 1)) (fun k => (1 : ℚ) / (k.factorial : ℚ)) +
        (1 : ℚ) / (((N * N.factorial : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℚ) =

          (fun k => (1 : ℚ) / (((k * (k + 1) * (k + 1).factorial : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℚ)) := by
  refine Nat.le_induction ?base (fun n hn hP => ?_) N hN
  · norm_num
  · have hnpos : n ≠ 0 := by omega
    have hpos : (n : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact mod_cast hnpos
    have hspos : (n.succ : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
    have hfactpos : ((n.factorial : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by simp
    have hsfactpos : ((n.succ.factorial : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by simp
    
    have hsub : n.succ - 1 = n := by omega
    
    have hIcc_eq : Finset.Icc (1 : ℕ) n = insert n (Finset.Icc (1 : ℕ) (n - 1)) := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        rcases Finset.mem_Icc.1 hx with ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
        by_cases hx_eq : x = n
        · subst x; exact Finset.mem_insert_self n _
        · apply Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
          apply Finset.mem_Icc.mpr
          refine ⟨hx1, ?_⟩
          omega
      · intro hx
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hx with (hx | hx)
        · subst hx
          apply Finset.mem_Icc.mpr
          refine ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
        · rcases Finset.mem_Icc.1 hx with ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
          apply Finset.mem_Icc.mpr
          refine ⟨hx1, ?_⟩
          omega
    
    have h_notmem : n ∉ Finset.Icc (1 : ℕ) (n - 1) := by
      intro hx
      rcases Finset.mem_Icc.1 hx with ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
      have : n ≤ n - 1 := hx2
      omega
    
    have hRHS_expand : Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 (n.succ - 1))
          (fun k => (1 : ℚ) / (((k * (k + 1) * (k + 1).factorial : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℚ)) =
        Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 (n - 1))
          (fun k => (1 : ℚ) / (((k * (k + 1) * (k + 1).factorial : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℚ)) +
        (1 : ℚ) / (((n * (n + 1) * (n + 1).factorial : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
      rw [hsub, hIcc_eq, Finset.sum_insert h_notmem]
    
    set S := Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 (n - 1))
      (fun k => (1 : ℚ) / (((k * (k + 1) * (k + 1).factorial : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℚ)) with hS
    set A := (1 : ℚ) / (((n * n.factorial : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℚ) with hA
    set B := (1 : ℚ) / ((n.succ.factorial : ℚ)) with hB
    set C := (1 : ℚ) / (((n.succ * n.succ.factorial : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℚ) with hC
    set D := (1 : ℚ) / (((n * (n + 1) * (n + 1).factorial : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℚ) with hD
    
    have hkey : B + C + D = A := by
      dsimp [A, B, C, D]
      field_simp [hpos, hspos, hfactpos, hsfactpos]
      simp [Nat.cast_mul, mul_assoc]
      ring
    
    have hmiddle : ((3 : ℚ) - S) - A + B + C = (3 : ℚ) - (S + D) := by
      nlinarith
    
    calc
      Finset.sum (Finset.range (n.succ + 1)) (fun k => (1 : ℚ) / (k.factorial : ℚ)) +
          (1 : ℚ) / (((n.succ * n.succ.factorial : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℚ) =
          (Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun k => (1 : ℚ) / (k.factorial : ℚ)) + A) - A + B + C := by
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
        dsimp [A, B, C]
        ring
      _ = ((3 : ℚ) - S) - A + B + C := by
        rw [hP]
        dsimp [S]
      _ = (3 : ℚ) - (S + D) := hmiddle
      _ = (3 : ℚ) - Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 (n.succ - 1))
              (fun k => (1 : ℚ) / (((k * (k + 1) * (k + 1).factorial : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℚ)) := by
        rw [hRHS_expand]
